title: Building Foliations from Heegaard Diagrams
summary: Every closed orientable 3-manifold admits both a Heegaard splitting and a coorientable codimension-one foliation. We address the foliation realization problem: constructing a foliation directly from a Heegaard diagram of arbitrary genus. Using Gabai's sutured manifold theory, we introduce the notion of a meridional sutured handlebody and prove that every such handlebody decomposes, via basic sutured decomposition operations, into a Reeb component together with product disks.
